name: neon-nightclub-red-dress-glance
image_purpose: nightlife social content and fashion profile visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic candid nightlife photograph taken by someone else inside a crowded nightclub, with vivid magenta and red lighting.
prompt.main_subject: One adult woman with an original non-celebrity identity, fair skin with visible light freckles, soft-glam nightclub makeup, defined brows, subtle eyeliner, muted rosy-nude lips, and long straight copper-auburn hair with a clean center part. She wears a secure red satin or lycra bottle-service outfit with thin straps and smooth form-fitting seams, plus a delicate choker or short chain necklace. Keep the outfit opaque and unbranded.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 mid-to-full-body framing from head to upper thighs. The adult woman stands in a nightclub aisle near the dance floor or VIP walkway, body turned away while twisting her upper torso back toward the camera. One arm raises a tall unbranded dark glass bottle upright near her head, elbow bent, while the other arm rests close to her body. Keep the over-shoulder gaze confident and slightly playful.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Low-light nightclub scene with vivid magenta and red lighting, soft rim highlights on hair and shoulders, atmospheric haze, blurred silhouettes of clubgoers, bokeh light dots, and a glossy reflective floor edge. Use realistic exposure, crisp subject detail, strong background bokeh, and no readable signage or logos.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic candid nightlife photo taken by someone else, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, shallow depth of field, sharp subject, detailed freckles, skin sheen, opaque fabric, hair strands, bottle reflections, and haze, no flash, no text, no watermark.
